cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

mechanism: A grades its former pupil first apology and then teaches a second one for the prolonged silence after missing A concert.
confusable: Not refusing the original apology: A accepts attendance repair but reveals the separate hurt of waiting to be acknowledged.
comparison: Unprompted acknowledgment after missed concert versus false blame after broken vase.
seedUse: D219 concert/apology/okay/words/all week; S05 taught prompt ownership.
